purpose: Determine whether replay telemetry itself contains sufficient geometry for trustworthy world-occlusion raycasts.

interpretation.ifDirectBounds: Direct networked bounds are candidates only. Axis-aligned or render bounds must not automatically be treated as bullet-collision geometry.
interpretation.ifModelResourcesRequired: Replay telemetry provides entity/world metadata but apparently does not directly expose enough primitive geometry for trustworthy building-level raycasts. The next stage should recover compiled map/model collision resources from the local Deadlock installation.
interpretation.positiveControlPlan: Any future LOS implementation must be validated against Script116 successful-hit anchors. A large rate of supposedly blocked successful hits would invalidate the LOS reconstruction.
interpretation.behavioralGuardrail: Script117 geometry rows remain candidate context only. No row becomes an actionable secure/deny opportunity until occlusion and weapon constraints are incorporated.
